notes.k: Upper bound is mean + k * ensemble standard deviation.
notes.utilisation_limit: Accept only if upper bound / capacity <= this value on every link.
notes.max_relative_std: Reject if any link has std / capacity above this value, even when the mean is low.
notes.fallback: Try last accepted action, then shortest-path routing. If both fail the gate, still apply shortest-path and mark last_resort.
